newsitem.title: GERMANY: German MAN restructures industrial unit.
newsitem.headline: German MAN restructures industrial unit.

text.p: German truckmaker and engineering company MAN said on Monday a restructuring of its industrial activities had led to a number of disposals.
MAN said the SMS Schloemann-Siemag AG group was taking over its high-temperature oven, steelworks technology and secondary metallurgy activities from its existing industrial unit.
The Ferrostaal AG group would at the same time be acquiring a range of other activities from that unit which had regional synergies with Ferrostahl's existing markets.

No financial details were given on the deals, however the activities to be acquired by Ferrostahl were estimated to have a turnover of around 180 million, with the SMS-acquired operations having revenues of about 300 million marks.
